description: DeFi data from DefiLlama in four modes. protocol: TVL, 1d/7d change, category, market cap and chain breakdown of a protocol (slug or name, e.g. aave, uniswap, lido). top: largest protocols by TVL, optional category (e.g. Lending, Dexs, Liquid Staking) and chain filter. chains: chains ranked by TVL with share. dex_volume: 24h/7d/30d DEX volume and top DEXes, optionally for one chain. Params: mode (protocol, top, chains, dex_volume; default top, or protocol if protocol is given), protocol, category, chain, limit (1 to 50, default 10). Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"mode":"protocol","protocol":"aave"}.

chain.description: Chain name, e.g. Base, Ethereum (modes top, dex_volume)
